name: Intro to Analog Collage by BINSUBU
description:
Intro to Analog Collage by BINSUBU

All materials required for the collage session will be provided.

Join our analog collage workshop to:

-Explore your artistic side, relieve stress, and connect with like-minded souls.

-Learn new techniques, boost your creativity, and enjoy a relaxing session of self-expression.

-Create playful or more moodboard collages.

-You’ll leave with a unique piece of art that’s all your own, and have the chance to meet new people and make something truly special.

During the session, Bindu will guide you through various techniques to help you discover a theme for your collage, overcome creative blocks, and experience the therapeutic benefits of the process. She will teach you how to compose your artwork, whether you prefer a simplistic or complex approach, offering advice on composition, scale, color, and form. Together, you will explore the journey of adding and subtracting elements to create your piece. Whether you start with a defined subject or allow the work to reveal its message to you, the goal is to tap into a flow state where creativity thrives.

About Bindu Reddy - The Collagist

Bindu Reddy is a collagist and textile artist with 20 years of expertise in collage. As a visual artist she enjoys working with both analog and digital collages, and creatively transforms her ideas into textiles through digital printing. She owns and runs a whimsical art studio and brand called BINSUBU, based in Bangalore. BINSUBU is known for its playful, often surreal, digitally printed textiles and artwork, each piece thoughtfully crafted with a unique story behind it.

name: The Shift: Helloween
description:
**THE SHIFT: HELLOWEEN**

An ode to Bollywood's darker side.

Halloween has a different kind of horror when Bollywood gets involved.

Forget the usual Halloween playbook. This year, The Shift pays homage to Bollywood and the horror films that gave us haunted havelis, sinister secrets, supernatural encounters, unforgettable villains, and stories that stayed with us long after the credits rolled.

On October 30, we're bringing that universe to life with a night that blends cinematic nostalgia, unapologetic music, and a little beautiful madness. This isn't Halloween as you know it. This is Helloween, the Bollywood way.

**BEHIND THE DECKS**

**DJ Jasmeet** — Known for high-energy sets and an instinct for reading the dance floor, DJ Jasmeet brings Bollywood favourites into the world of electronic and club sounds. Expect familiar hooks, unexpected switches, and a dance floor that doesn't stay still for long.

**Sa-Rang** — Bringing together Bollywood, Bollytech, and Amapiano, Sa-Rang adds another dimension to the night's sound. Expect the nostalgia of Bollywood meeting electronic rhythms and global dance-floor energy.

**BEHIND THE BAR**

**Bombay Daak** — A modern take on India's culture, Bombay Daak celebrates the spirit of neighborhood drinking spots through inventive cocktails, nostalgic influences, and food made to be enjoyed over another round. Expect a bar takeover with character, where what's in the glass is just as much a part of the experience as what's happening around you.

**THE NIGHT, IN NUMBERS**

*DRESS TO DISTRESS.* Bring your most twisted horror look. The best-dressed guest walks away with ₹10,000 in prize money. Make it count.

**IMPORTANT:** A Helloween costume is mandatory. No costume, no entry. No refunds will be issued.

*THE SHIFT: HELLOWEEN*

*October 30 | The Humming Tree, Bengaluru*

*An ode to Bollywood. A tribute to its horrors. A soundtrack for the beautifully unhinged.*

The Shift is an IP of Foreword Culture.

name: BuCo Exclusive Breakfast Preview ft. Putting Scene
description:
You’re invited to an exclusive preview of BuCo., a first taste of our menu before we officially open our doors in Bangalore.

BuCo. began in Mangaluru, a coastal town whose flavours have always deserved more attention than they get. We started as an artisanal bakery built on one belief: the best food comes from knowing exactly where your ingredients come from and exactly what you’re doing with them.

Today, BuCo. is a modern neighbourhood cafe rooted in Karnataka’s culture.

Our menu is anchored in regional flavours and seasonal produce, with a fully in-house bakery that brings European baking techniques to local ingredients. All of it is backed by a serious filter coffee program.

Everything is made in house, and every element is locally sourced. We don’t take shortcuts. That isn’t because it’s trendy. It’s because the food demands it.

After our flagship store in the heart of Mangaluru, we’re now bringing BuCo. to Bangalore.

name: DIY Camera Obscura
description:
Build & Experiment with a Handmade Pinhole Camera

Long before lenses and megapixels, there was the *camera obscura*—a simple box, a pinhole, and the magic of light painting an image. In this workshop with artist **Stuti Bansal**, you’ll make your own camera obscura from scratch, explore the principles of analogue image-making, and develop unique photographs using light-sensitive paper.

**You’ll get to:**

- Build your own **working camera obscura**
- Learn the science & history behind the camera obscura
- Experiment with capturing and developing images
- Take home your handmade camera + prints you create

**Who is it for?**

Artists, photographers, makers, students, and anyone curious about analog photography and light-based art. No prior experience required.

name: Behind the Loop: Bringing The Invisible Labour Powering AI into Focus
description:
​Following a **screening of the movie 'Humans in the Loop' (2024)**, this event will explore the often invisible human inputs behind AI. ​Join us for the full event, or after the screening for the active section including games and a discussion with the director.

**​Part 1 | *11:00 AM – Film screening (Doors open at 10:30 AM)***

​What to expect

- ​A screening of Humans in the Loop, followed by a conversation with director Aranya Sahay
- ​In the Pipeline, a role-playing game that puts you inside the world of data work
- ​A fishbowl conversation where you can step inside and become part of the discussion, or observe from the outside.
- ​Lunch, tea & coffee, and good company

name: Perspectives of OCD - A zine making workshop
description:
Conversations about OCD often revolve around pop-culture representation, which centres on cleanliness and being organised. This workshop invites us to look beyond the diagnosis and to recognise the strengths, resilience, and humanity of individuals whose lives are often reduced to a diagnosis. We’ll create a space for experiences that often go unseen and unheard.

Through guided discussions, creative reflection, and collaborative zine-making, participants will explore these perspectives while contributing to a collective publication that captures diverse viewpoints about this disorder.

We welcome people with lived experience of OCD, their caregivers, students, educators, healthcare professionals, researchers, members of civil society organisations, policymakers, and anyone interested in mental health and creating more compassionate conversations around addiction.

*Diwali is always a little more special when it's shared with good people, good food, and traditions that take you back home.*

We're bringing together everything we love about Diwali: **a delicious, nourishing spread of festive treats, the nostalgic games** we grew up playing, and the little traditions that make this time of year feel so special. There'll be an **art corner** where you can paint your own **diya, mehendi cones** to get into the festive spirit, and plenty of opportunities to eat, play, and get to know the people around you.

If you're new to Bangalore, away from family, or simply want to join the festive cheer and find your community here, consider this your invitation. Bring your friends, come along with family, or show up on your own. There's always room for one more at our table!

name: The Humming Tree x Indian Music Experience x Jodhpur RIFF present Killabeatmaker (Colombia)
description:
**About the Artist:**

KillaBeatmaker is a Medellín-based Colombian DJ, producer, singer-songwriter and audio engineer known for blending ancestral South American and Afro-Colombian sounds with electronic bass and global club rhythms. His live band expands this sound into a dynamic fusion of live percussion, Colombian flute, synthesizers, vocals and electronic production, bringing together traditional instrumentation and contemporary club music.

Joined by Guadalupe and Yulian, the live setup combines Colombian folk percussion and gaita with Akai-driven sequences, MPCs and synths, creating an immersive, rhythm-heavy performance rooted in Colombia while looking firmly toward the global dance floor.

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.
